name: Hocking College
tuition_note: In-state all-inclusive tuition & fees (15-18 credits): $3,665/semester x 2 = $7,330/yr, effective May 1, 2026, from hocking.edu/tuition-fees (all-inclusive rate includes instructional, general, career services, health center, and learning materials fees; tuition-only rate is $3,270/sem = $6,540/yr). Housing room only: standard double at Sycamore/North/Downhour Hall $2,990/semester x 2 = $5,980/yr from hocking.edu/housing (single room $3,490/sem; housing+meal bundle $5,105/sem). Meals excluded from housing figure.
